summary: Modulprüfungsordnung Sport for the Lehramt an Hauptschulen und Realschulen of 30 January 2023 (in force from winter semester 2023/24). Wahlpflicht modules 8, 9, 10b and 11b are each obligatory (5, 5, 4 and 4 ECTS), plus one of Bewegungsfelder A, B or C (Modul 13/14/15, 5 ECTS). Compulsory modules 1, 2, 3b, 4, 5 and the practical semester (Modul 12) are not selection slots. Replacing the practical semester with a movement-field module (§ 5) applies only to extension and additional examinations.
